answer: We formulate a Sybil-resistant protocol wherein validators stake dynamic opportunity-cost bonds in jade collateral paired with zero-knowledge delay proofs on a shale ledger. A subgame-perfect slashing matrix expropriates non-unique signatures, scaling capital requirements linearly and rendering expected attack utility strictly negative whenever penalties exceed block rewards. Monitored by raven hardware enclaves, rational actors converge to a unique Nash equilibrium where honest validation strictly dominates identity multiplication.
